CACHED_ACCOUNT_IDENTITY.description: Cached display name, email, and avatar URI stored in encrypted local storage; safely rendered in You tab while offline.
CACHED_ACCOUNT_IDENTITY.claim_boundary: Read-only presentation of previously validated identity.

LOCAL_SECURE_SESSION_TOKEN.claim_boundary: Opaque bearer token retained locally across app restarts; never logged or exposed in deep links.

REMOTE_SESSION_VALIDITY.description: Backend token validity (active / revoked / expired) cannot be verified without GET /auth/me network exchange.
REMOTE_SESSION_VALIDITY.claim_boundary: Never assert '100% offline valid session' or 'authenticated with server'. The app fails open gracefully without forcing logout.

wording_corrections: Tier 2 documentation updated to state 'Cached identity and local session token available offline; remote session validity remains unverified until reconnection'
Removed any claims that authentication is 100% offline
